paths.name: @/lib/supabase-server
paths.message: v2 developer-API routes must authenticate by API key via validateApiKey() from '@/lib/api-auth', never by cookie/session. middleware.ts skips Supabase session creation for /api/v2/* AND serves open CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), so a cookie-authed v2 route would be a CSRF hole. See .claude/skills/kingflexy-developer-api/SKILL.md.

paths.name: next/headers
paths.message: v2 developer-API routes must not read cookies — they authenticate by API key via validateApiKey() from '@/lib/api-auth'. See .claude/skills/kingflexy-developer-api/SKILL.md.
